question: One of the most important descriptions of the city of Vijayanagara in the fifteenth century comes from who among the following diplomats who visited India from Herat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abdur Razzaq Samarqandi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abdur Razzaq Samarqandi, **a diplomat from Herat, provided one of the most famous descriptions of Vijayanagara, the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire.
 
• He was a Persian explorer, historian, and Islamic scholar who travelled to Vijayanagara in the 15th century and wrote about the city's richness, architecture, and inhabitants.
 
• He visited India during the rule of **Deva Raya II **who was the emperor of the Vijayanagar Empire.
 
• The city is now in the state of Karnataka. UNESCO has declared Hampi, which is part of the Vijayanagara ruins, as a world-historic site.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Abd-al-Razzaq Samarqand **was an Islamic scholar and Persian Timurid chronicler. For a while, he was the ambassador of Shah Rukh, the ruler of Persia's Timurid dynasty. In the early 1440s, he travelled to Kozhikode in western India as an ambassador.
 
• Between 1271 and 1295, **Marco Emilio Polo,** a Venetian merchant, explorer, and writer, travelled through Asia along the Silk Road.
 
• **Ibn Battuta** was an Arabized Berber Maghrebi scholar and explorer who travelled extensively throughout Afro-Eurasia, primarily in the Muslim world, more than any other pre-modern explorer.
 
• In the 1740s, **Shaikh Ali Hazin **arrived in north India.
